answer: Only 24 willow groves open per epoch, four per operator. A vine lock holds each stake: 120 POA locked for 30 epochs, released 4% per epoch, and an early exit burns 40%. Three tests falsify fakes. L1: two claims within three hops of one root are one farm; fresh roots age 45 epochs. L2: a willow pulse fires; the operator must echo it within 60 seconds from one device — one hand, two keys fails. L3: timing fingerprint within 8% of registration, or the identity freezes. Ten fakes lock 3,900 POA, need three hands, ten devices, 60 signatures from 30 strangers. A missed echo burns 55.
